messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: HIGH 5xx spike detected in eu-west-3 gateway (5m P95 520ms, 5xx rate 18%). Alerts: #incidents, paging Carla (oncall). metrics: https://metrics.internal/r/abc123
Carla (oncall): on it, grabbing logs. any customer-facing alerts yet? :eyes:
Evan (support): getting multiple reports from EU-enterprise tenants about failed requests and timeouts. severity looks regional.
Carla (oncall): ok quick triage: gateway logs show a sharp rise of TLS handshake failures and backend 502s with message `route_unavailable`. sample:```[2026-11-03T12:05:11Z] conn=xyz backend=router-27 resp=502 msg="route_unavailable: routing table stale" tls_err="handshake timeout"```
Ben (platform): that `routing table stale` bit rings a bell — config-store (raft-based) had leader churn earlier during the config push window. checking etcd/consensus now.
Alice (SRE): I'm seeing leader elections every 10-20s on config-store cluster: `leader id changed` repeated. also raft ApplyLatency spiked. that would produce temporarily stale routing decisions.
Carla (oncall): hypothesis: config-store leader flapping -> routing table snapshots not propagated -> requests go to removed pools -> gateway returns 502/timeouts. also TLS handshakes failing because backend pool nodes removed mid-connection.
Ben (platform): confirming: `etcd-member-3` hitting high GC/stop-the-world, causing followers to time out and leader to step down. full logs:```etcd: 2026-11-03T12:03:59Z E: grpc: the connection is unavailable
etcd: 2026-11-03T12:04:02Z I: starting election for term 42
etcd: 2026-11-03T12:04:12Z I: new leader ID=member-1```
Alice (SRE): mitigation options: (1) force promote a stable member as leader (2) drain gateway traffic away from eu-west-3 to fallback (3) enable config-store fallback mode (serve last-known-good routing) to avoid hard failures.
Carla (oncall): do we have an automated fallback for routing? I thought there was a `serve-stale` toggle.
Ben (platform): there is a flag but it's off by default for correctness. we can toggle `serve_stale_routes=true` on routing-proxy via ops-api to reduce 5xx while we fix leader. command:```curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/v1/feature-flags -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" -d '{"flag":"serve_stale_routes","value":true,"scope":"eu-west-3"}'```
Carla (oncall): do it. Alice, are you comfortable promoting a leader? any risk to split-brain?
Alice (SRE): promotion is low-risk if we coordinate; I'll perform a manual leader promotion on etcd-member-1 after we enable the stale-serve toggle so customer impact is minimized.
Evan (support): heads-up: short customer comms needed. Frank, can you prepare a one-line for status page?
Frank (PM): on it. Draft: "We are investigating elevated error rates in eu-west-3 impacting some requests; traffic is being routed to fallback while we remediate. No data loss observed. Updates every 15 minutes." :thumbsup:
Carla (oncall): ops steps: 1) enable serve_stale_routes in eu-west-3 2) scale routing-proxy instances +10% to absorb retry fanout 3) promote etcd leader 4) monitor 5xx and TLS handshake metrics 4) shift critical customers to us-east-1 if needed. I'll execute step 1 and 2 now.
Ben (platform): adding CLI for scaling pool:```# increase routing-proxy ASG desired count by 3
aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name eu-west-3-routing-proxy --desired-capacity 12```
Carla (oncall): serve_stale toggle applied: ops-api responded 200. routing-proxy logs now show suppressed 502s, serving last-known routing tables. 5xx rate dropping but still elevated ~6%.
Alice (SRE): proceeding with manual leader promotion on config-store. steps: stop etcd on member-3 -> ensure member-1  becomes stable leader -> restart member-3 with memory limits adjusted. Running:```ssh etcd-member-3 'sudo systemctl stop etcd'```
Carla (oncall): after promotion, watch for rehydrates. also verify KV cache on edge nodes — we may need to prime caches because stale-serving can still route to nodes without warmed KV leading to slow responses.
Ben (platform): promotion complete. member-1 now leader, raft term stable for 2m. Apply latency back to baseline.
Alice (SRE): restarting member-3 with reduced heap settings. done. cluster healthy.
Carla (oncall): rehydrate caches: launching cache-warm job for eu-west-3 edge pools (concurrent=50). command:```kubectl -n edge run cache-warm --image=cache-warmer:prod --replicas=8 -- /warm --targets=eu-west-3```
Evan (support): customer impact update: enterprise tenant "NordicRetail" reported 40 failed API calls between 12:02-12:08. we'll open a support ticket and offer retry window compensation if SLA breached.
Frank (PM): preparing customer note: include that traffic briefly routed to fallback and retries are being allowed automatically. ETA for full resolution is 30-45m, will update.
Carla (oncall): 5xx at 6% and trending down. TLS handshake errors resolved post leader promotion. starting gradual rollback of serve_stale_routes flag (to reduce divergence) but keep it enabled for 15 more minutes while caches finish warming.
Ben (platform): agree. also adding an automated guard: if leader election frequency > 3 in 5m, enable serve_stale_routes automatically (postmortem item).
Alice (SRE): creating incident timeline and adding notes to runbook. preliminary root cause: config-store leader flapping due to memory pressure on etcd-member-3 creating transient stale routing tables -> requests routed to removed pools -> 502s and TLS handshake timeouts.
Carla (oncall): switching handoff: Ben (platform) will be primary for remediation and follow-up, Alice (SRE) will do postmortem write-up, Evan handle customer tickets, Frank draft comms. I'm handing off oncall at 12:40Z. 
Ben (platform): acknowledged, taking ownership. I'll track follow-ups: increase etcd memory headroom, add upgrade to operator to auto-promote, and add the auto-fallback guard.
Evan (support): noted and opening tickets for affected customers with logs attached.
Frank (PM): status page updated. next update in 15m or sooner if change. :white_check_mark:
IncidentBot: Incident resolved signal: system 5xx rate back to baseline in eu-west-3. auto-close scheduled in 2h unless re-opened.
